title: Textarea: Ghost (no background) (daisyUI)
notes:
Textarea allows users to enter text in multiple lines.

Needs daisyUI installed (npm i -D daisyui, then @plugin "daisyui" in your CSS).

Original file: https://github.com/saadeghi/daisyui/blob/master/packages/docs/src/routes/(routes)/components/textarea/+page.md
